nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Hierarchical Bayesian regression normative model per region; PCNtoolkit v0.20 implementation with transfer learning calibration to ADNI.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: A hierarchical Bayesian regression model was trained on multisite data to generate normative models per region using the covariates age and sex. All modeling steps are performed using PCNtoolkit (version 0.20).

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Cortical thickness values across 148 Destrieux atlas regions (including mean cortical thickness).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Cortical thickness measurements across 148 brain regions were obtained from T1-weighted MRI scans from 62 sites of the Alzheimer ' s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative. This included the mean cortical thickness and 148 regions cortical thickness values for each participant.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Verdi2023.pdf.md: Methods / Estimation of Cortical Thickness

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were used as primary predictors, while site noise was adjusted for using a hierarchical framework that pools parameters across multiple scanning sites.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: used hierarchical Bayesian regression to predict cortical thickness per region using age and sex, while adjusting for site noise.
